onet.task: Calculate, prepare, and issue bills, invoices, account statements, and other financial statements according to established procedures.
technologies: Data base user interface and query software

steps.title: Open the supplier invoice and review its header and lines

decision.description: Read the item and amount to decide whether the pre-filled expense account fits the nature of the purchase.
decision.from_value: Expense Head pre-filled from item default
decision.counterfactual: For a genuine small-tool purchase the default small-tools account would be left unchanged.

steps.title: Correct the Expense Head when the purchase is capital equipment

decision.description: Change the expense account from the small-tools default to the fixed-asset account because the {invoice.amount} exceeds the capitalization threshold.
decision.counterfactual: Below the threshold the line would stay in small tools.

steps.title: Align the Cost Center with the capital booking

decision.description: Move the cost center from the default to the production cost center so it matches the capital-equipment booking.
decision.counterfactual: If the equipment were booked to small tools the default cost center would remain.

steps.title: Save the corrected invoice and return to the list
Open the next invoice and check it against memory of prior bills

decision.description: Recognize that the {invoice.amount} matches an already-paid invoice from the same supplier and suspect a duplicate bill.
decision.counterfactual: An unfamiliar amount or supplier would be processed normally.

steps.title: Put the suspected duplicate invoice On Hold and save
Open the next invoice and identify which company and currency it belongs to

guardrails.text: Equipment purchases above 5,000 must be booked to Plants and Machineries with the Production cost center, never to small tools.
When a supplier invoice repeats an amount already paid (known December double-billing pattern), set Tags to On Hold and wait for the supplier to confirm before processing.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Okay, the Feldmark invoice. An air compressor for eight thousand four hundred.

translations.de: Okay, die Rechnung von Feldmark. Ein Druckluftkompressor für achttausendvierhundert.
translations.fr: D'accord, la facture de Feldmark. Un compresseur d'air pour huit mille quatre cents.
translations.es: Vale, la factura de Feldmark. Un compresor de aire por ocho mil cuatrocientos.
translations.ru: Хорошо, счёт от Feldmark. Компрессор воздушный на восемь тысяч четыреста.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.

translations.de: Auf Kleinwerkzeuge gebucht, das ist für einen Kompressor falsch.
translations.fr: Comptabilisé en petits outillages, c'est faux pour un compresseur.
translations.es: Contabilizado en herramientas menores, eso está mal para un compresor.
translations.ru: Списано на мелкий инструмент, для компрессора это неверно.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Equipment over 5,000 is always capex here, so it goes to Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center, never to small tools.

translations.de: Anlagen über 5.000 sind hier immer CAPX, also gehört es auf Anlagen und Maschinen und die Kostenstelle Produktion, niemals auf Kleinwerkzeuge.
translations.fr: Les équipements de plus de 5 000 sont toujours en capex ici, donc cela va en Machines et Équipements et sur le centre de coûts Production, jamais en petits outillages.
translations.es: Los equipos de más de 5.000 siempre son capex aquí, así que va a Maquinaria y Equipos y al centro de costes de Producción, nunca a herramientas menores.
translations.ru: Оборудование свыше 5 000 здесь всегда капитальные затраты, значит это идёт на Станки и оборудование и на центр затрат Производство, но никогда на мелкий инструмент.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Velt again. Two eight fifty, that number looks familiar from December.

translations.de: Velt schon wieder. Zweitausendachthundertfünfzig, die Zahl kommt mir von Dezember bekannt vor.
translations.fr: Encore Velt. Deux mille huit cent cinquante, ce chiffre me rappelle décembre.
translations.es: Velt otra vez. Dos mil ochocientos cincuenta, esa cifra me suena de diciembre.
translations.ru: Опять Velt. Две тысячи восемьсот пятьдесят, эта сумма кажется знакомой с декабря.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.

translations.de: Dieselbe Summe wie die Dezemberrechnung, die wir bereits bezahlt haben.
translations.fr: Le même montant que la facture de décembre que nous avons déjà payée.
translations.es: El mismo importe que la factura de diciembre que ya pagamos.
translations.ru: Та же сумма, что и в декабрьском счёте, который мы уже оплатили.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.

translations.de: Dieser Lieferant stellt jede doppelte Rechnung im Dezember; zurückhalten, bis sie bestätigen. Gleicher Betrag, nur ein Suffix an der alten Rechnungsnummer.
translations.fr: Ce fournisseur double la facture chaque décembre ; retenons-la jusqu'à confirmation. Même montant, juste un suffixe sur l'ancien numéro de facture.
translations.es: Este proveedor factura dos veces cada diciembre; retenerla hasta que lo confirmen. Mismo importe, solo un sufijo en el número de la factura antigua.
translations.ru: Этот поставщик каждый декабрь выставляет двойной счёт; удержать до их подтверждения. Та же сумма, только суффикс к старому номеру счёта.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: No — below 5,000 it stays an expense, small tools is fine then.
